original.target_description: Experiment 1, error rate. Paper contains a number-by-congruency interaction and simple congruency effects for one versus two IDENTICAL movements. Locator does not distinguish which test is intended; two mutually conflicting movements were instead compared with NO movement. No unique two-conflicting-agents versus one-agent contrast established.

replication.target_description: Experiment 1, one versus two IDENTICAL hand movements crossed with congruent versus incongruent movement. Methods state that when both hands moved they always performed the same movement. Number main effect, congruency main effect, interaction, and simple effects are different tests; input supplies no replication locator to identify one.

notes: Blindness limitation: the initial general primary-paper web search inadvertently returned FORRT-domain search snippets. No FORRT page was opened. Statistics below were taken only from author-provided primary paper text. Full primary paper text was accessible for both sides. The description is shared by another assigned audit ID but no distinguishing outcome condition or test is supplied; input order was not used to assign tests. Original p. 5 contains figures and discussion; numerical analyses are on proof p. 4. Statistics left null because the target contrast is not uniquely established. This is a locator failure, not paper unavailability.
